Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Define the compound set from parent CHEMBL2105717 through molecule_hierarchy to include the parent and all related salts. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL3717 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit the number of rows.
